evidence.description: Independently re-confirmed the contract's own 'Pre-existing spec confirmation' line citations for REQ-105 (line 650) and REQ-106/108/109's cited passages: REQ-105's own text (lines 650-828) genuinely, verbatim supports the kill-switch tie-break framing and the successfulOnTimeRepayments===0 cold-start trigger condition the sprint-2 orchestrator implements -- no rewrite of REQ-101 through REQ-114's own already-hardened text was needed or made.

`git diff --stat 71cc1c9~1..HEAD` for all four sprint-1-delivered files across every sprint-2 commit (71cc1c9 RED, 1b1fae2 GREEN, 3151f13 refactor) returns empty -- confirmed byte-identical, no incidental edits, matching CRIT-201's own 'no incidental edits' requirement and the contract's own Files-touched claim.

The Design decision section's 15-vs-4 issuance/servicing split, and the two-separate-orchestrator-functions rationale, both genuinely match the actual code structure (executeLoanIssuanceAttempt vs. executeRepaymentClaim/executeDefaultDetectionSweep, disjoint lock scopes) -- not merely asserted in prose.

8 of REQ-115's 9 canonical steps (1,2,3 x2 sub-cases,4,5 x2,6,8,9 x3 sub-cases) have dedicated, passing failure-injection tests against the REAL executeLoanIssuanceAttempt. Step 7 (decideLoan sizing refusal) has no such test anywhere in the file -- see FIND-C203.
119/119 tests pass, 0 fail, matching the contract's own claimed count (89 pre-existing + 30 new) exactly -- independently re-run and confirmed, not accepted from a prior log.

Full control-flow read confirms the 9-step issuance order, the two-phase provisional/follow-up append discipline (activeStatusFields helper, used identically at both the step-5 reconciliation-success and step-9 disbursement-success call sites per the contract's own Phase 2c refactor note), and the try/catch discipline at step 8 (append) and step 9 (disburse) are all implemented correctly and match REQ-106's own already-specified shape.

PROP-108a's Tier-3 'proved' status in state.json is backed by pre-sprint-2, pre-orchestrator evidence (a single historical/borrowed txHash tested only against verifyRepayment directly) -- see FIND-C202. This is the one CRIT-206-scoped defect found; the rest of the implementation is correct.

Independently re-verified via direct source read (not just trusting the passing test): executeLoanIssuanceAttempt references only resolveLoanLockAcquisitionOrder's own per-lender/per-borrower keys (never loan_${loanId}); executeRepaymentClaim/executeDefaultDetectionSweep reference only loan_${loanId} (never the per-lender/per-borrower keys) -- CRIT-204's dual-lock scope separation genuinely holds, confirmed both structurally and via the passing PROP-115d/PROP-116c staggered-race integration tests.

Exactly one export each of executeLoanIssuanceAttempt/executeRepaymentClaim/executeDefaultDetectionSweep confirmed via direct grep; no LLM/prompt reference anywhere in the file. One minor literal-wording gap noted (FIND-C204, non-blocking): a raw successfulOnTimeRepayments===0 comparison in evaluateKillSwitches, which mirrors REQ-105's own already-hardened, spec-mandated dispatch condition rather than inventing new judgment logic.

CRIT-207 confirmed PASS: a genuine 1b->1c transition ('Gate 1c already recorded PASS (fresh adversary, iteration 3, zero findings)') is recorded before the 1c->2a transition that opened Phase 2 -- the Phase 1c gate was not skipped.
CRIT-205 FAIL: all 19 of the contract's own targeted-for-closure PROP IDs remain status:'skipped' (not 'proved'), contradicting the contract's own text and CRIT-205's passThreshold -- see FIND-C201.
Non-blocking digest mismatch noted -- see FIND-C205.

summaryForBuilder: Code and tests are genuinely strong (119/119 real, independently-rerun tests; dual-lock scope, 8-of-9-step edge-case coverage, and sprint-1 file immutability all independently verified). This round FAILs on two verification-readiness/correctness gaps rather than on the orchestrator logic itself: (1) FIND-C201 -- none of the 19 deferred PROP IDs the contract commits to closing this sprint were actually flipped to status:proved in state.json, even though most already have passing evidence in the test suite; this looks like a missed bookkeeping step, not missing work. (2) FIND-C202 -- state.json's PROP-108a (Tier-3 live E2E) entry is still marked proved using pre-orchestrator, borrowed-artifact evidence from sprint-1, which is exactly what CRIT-206 was written to prevent; either honestly re-defer it or attempt the real disbursement+repayment pair through the new orchestrator. (3) FIND-C203 -- add one more failure-injection test for step 7 (sizing refusal) to genuinely close the '9 canonical steps' claim. FIND-C204/FIND-C205 are non-blocking housekeeping notes.
